We have few players complaining abou two clarifications about a card.

Legacy of Pander, Political Action, Sabbat, R , [Sabbat:R, SW:R]
{Requires a} Sabbat vampire. If this referendum is successful, put this card in play. Each non-titled Pander has 1 vote. Any Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to burn this card as a +1 stealth political action.

LSJ clarification:
groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/wuhgIV-vu2U/WZSUz51u-DAJ

Legacy of Pander [SAB] - Political Action
* Legacy of Pander is cumulative. [LSJ 971118]

VEKN Errata
www.vekn.net/card-lists/77-sw-whats-changed

Legacy of Pander. Gives each non-titled Pander one vote, not one additional vote. (You can have more than one in play, but doing so will still result in each non-titled Pander having one vote. Similar to being named for more than one Rumors of Gehenna - there is no benefit other than needing more actions to remove the bonus).

What is the right rulling?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Sydnelson wrote:
> What is the right rulling?
>
The 1997 ruling was based on Legacy of Pander's then-current card text ("one additional vote"). The card text was changed in Sabbat War ("one vote"), and the earlier ruling is therefore no longer relevant.

Short version: even if you have 50 Legacy of Pander in play, Basil casts one vote.
